instruction: The starter part bore_plate.step is already loaded. Spot drill and drill the four through holes in C:\Users\User\Desktop\bore_plate.step. Machine the two stepped holes using Bore, Profile, or Pocket operations. Through holes must break through the bottom by 1 mm and stepped holes must bottom at Z=9.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a spot drill, T2 is a 6 mm drill, and T3 is a 10 mm flat end mill for bore/profile/pocket operations. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-8.nc.
source: SolidCAM 模块总览含 2.5D Milling、AFRM、Turning、Mill-Turn 等模块：https://solidcam.com/cam-modules/modules-overview/ (SolidCAM)
